pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **"The Noisemaker" can't buy a clue, and as for "Bubba G," congrats on backing both horses in the same race—that's a masterclass in cowardice!** Look at me, Gunner—LOOK AT ME. You've got both France and Morocco going head-to-head in Foxborough, and I bet you think that's a shrewd move. Really, it's nothing but spineless hedging from the '90s playbook, and it speaks volumes about your unwillingness to stake your claim like an American should. When I look at your 68 points, what I see is squandered potential—especially when you don't even take a risk on the upset bonus. Here's my ironclad, copper-bottomed prediction: France will steamroll Morocco quicker than you can say "déjà vu," proving once more that you're the king of playing it safe. And Rafe—"The Noisemaker"—with your anemic 29 points, you couldn’t pick a winner if the teams were labeled "Winner" and "Loser." You’ve chosen Germany, hoping for a resurrection of old Teutonic magic, but son, you should stick to TikTok challenges because senior managerial roles ain't for you. Let me tell you something, when the dust settles and Zach’s Switzerland rides a penalty shootout into oblivion, maybe you all will realize that this isn’t just fantasy—it’s a referendum on your very souls.
